San Francisco Critical Mass

San Francisco, CA · Social

San Francisco Critical Mass is a social group ride in San Francisco, CA. It rolls last Friday of the month at 5:30 pm from Embarcadero Plaza (foot of Market Street). Pace: mass ride, slow. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: mass ride, slow. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the San Francisco Critical Mass group ride

The original Critical Mass, riding since 1992. No one is in charge and everyone is invited. Gather at the Embarcadero at the foot of Market Street on the last Friday and roll with the crowd. Bring your bike.
